summary.text: Cherielynn Westrich, a Republican, represents District 13 in the Iowa Senate; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Westrich as serving a first Senate term after one term in the Iowa House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: The biography describes Westrich as owner of MalWood USA LLC, which makes hydraulic clutch pedal systems, and as a professional car builder, welder, vehicle restoration expert and professional musician and vocalist.
It lists Jefferson College in Hillsboro, Missouri (1984) under education, and says Westrich was born in St. Louis, Missouri, and lives in Ottumwa.
